crossRefs.note: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is…
Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
“Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

translations.web: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”
translations.bsb: He continued, “Come, let us try to reach one of these towns to spend the night in Gibeah or Ramah.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
translations.asv: And he said unto his servant, Come and let us draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
